extensions.scope: Public surfaces (.ww scope: /pageInicio landing, public navbar and footer, /login, /registrar, /listPlanInicio, /listPlanUser) and the developer shell (sidebar lane plus the /pageUser dashboard). Other logged-in developer screens and the whole company area remain Angular Material indigo-pink with Roboto; known boundary, not part of this system.

display.purpose: The single word under pressure in the hero; one per page. Condensed via font-stretch 88%.

display-quiet.purpose: Light 300 run-in line before the pressure word; light register of the plan band title.

headline.purpose: Section titles, max 16ch, font-stretch 92%. Closing door names use it at 800 / 88% width.

title.purpose: Lane titles in the role's text color.

mono.purpose: Commit hashes and commit messages only; 0.75rem under 720px.

pressure.purpose: Pressure word on /login, /registrar and the plans pages, under a Display Quiet run-in; one per page.

figure.purpose: Numbers that are the content: usage meters 3.25rem (2.75rem under 560px), plan prices clamp(2.25rem, 3.6vw, 3.25rem), plan limits 2rem in Deep Branch Green. Tabular numbers.

meta.purpose: Field labels (600), plan limit terms, dates and counts under list items, the plans disclaimer.

small.purpose: Input hints and field errors (600); sidebar labels on mobile.

line.name: ww-line
line.purpose: The single stroke weight: lanes, curves, node rings, dividers, pill borders, underlines, focus outlines.

motion.name: ww-ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing in the world; all state changes and entrances.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Door and pill-link fill changes, arrow nudge (translateX 4px).

motion.name: state-slow
motion.purpose: Lane dim to 0.22 opacity on door focus; closing door brightness 1.06.

motion.name: replay-stagger
motion.purpose: Per-row delay of the commit graph replay on load; lanes 520ms scaleY, curves 640ms clip reveal, nodes 420ms scale-in, messages 520ms blur-fade.

motion.name: merge-ring
motion.purpose: One-shot vermillion ring from the merge node to an 18px offset; plays once, last.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All entrance choreography is gated behind this query.

motion.name: form-lane
motion.purpose: Form and dashboard lanes draw on entry (scaleY/scaleX); nodes scale in 420ms with a 150ms stagger; gated by reduced motion.

focus.name: role
focus.purpose: Developer and company doors keep their role color in focus.

focus.name: on-ink
focus.purpose: Focus inside the ink plan band.

focus.name: panel-inset
focus.value: outline-offset: -8px; ink on green, white on indigo

focus.name: role-ink
focus.value: outline-color: var(--role-ink); input focus underline var(--role-ink) on Deep Concrete fill
focus.purpose: Form fields, submit buttons, sidebar stops and dashboard rows inside role-colored surfaces.

breakpoints.name: hero-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Hero becomes one column; graph max-width 560px.

breakpoints.name: nav-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Navbar links collapse behind the pill menu toggle.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Lanes, closing doors, and footer stack; join fork hidden; mono 0.75rem; doors 48px.

breakpoints.name: dash-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Dashboard grid becomes one column; side column gets a 3px ink top rule.

breakpoints.name: auth-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Auth and plans heads stack; auth intro no longer sticky.

breakpoints.name: sidebar-horizontal
breakpoints.purpose: Developer sidebar becomes a horizontal lane above the content.

breakpoints.name: plans-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Plan columns stack with 3px ink top rules.

breakpoints.name: fields-stack
breakpoints.purpose: Paired form fields and the two usage meters stack.

components.css: .ds-graph { --lane-x: 22px; --node: 14px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; max-width: 480px; background: var(--ww-ground); } .ds-row { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 60px; } .ds-row::before, .ds-row::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: var(--ww-line); } .ds-row::before { left: calc(var(--lane-x) - var(--ww-line) / 2); background: var(--ww-dev); } .ds-row::after { right: calc(var(--lane-x) - var(--ww-line) / 2); background: var(--ww-co); } .ds-node { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: var(--node); height: var(--node); margin-top: calc(var(--node) / -2); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ww-ground); border: var(--ww-line) solid; box-sizing: border-box; z-index: 1; } .ds-node-dev { left: calc(var(--lane-x) - var(--node) / 2); border-color: var(--ww-dev); } .ds-node-co { right: calc(var(--lane-x) - var(--node) / 2); border-color: var(--ww-co); } .ds-msg { font-family: var(--ww-font-mono); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ww-ink); } .ds-hash { margin-right: 0.6em; color: var(--ww-ink-soft); } .ds-msg-dev { padding-left: calc(var(--lane-x) + 22px); margin-right: auto; max-width: 46%; } .ds-msg-co { padding-right: calc(var(--lane-x) + 22px); margin-left: auto; text-align: right; max-width: 46%; } .ds-merge { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .ds-merge svg { display: block; width: calc(100% - 44px); height: 77px; overflow: visible; fill: none; stroke-width: var(--ww-line); } .ds-merge path { vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-merge .d { stroke: var(--ww-dev); } .ds-merge .c { stroke: var(--ww-co); } .ds-merge-node { width: 26px; height: 26px; margin-top: -13px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ww-merge); } .ds-msg-merge { margin-top: 10px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
WebWorks is told as git history. The developer owns a green branch, the company owns an indigo branch, and the two lanes run down the page until they merge in the application, marked by the only vermillion on the screen. Everything is drawn with one line: a single 3px ink stroke carries lanes, section dividers, borders, underlines, and focus outlines, so the page reads like one continuous diagram rather than a stack of cards.

The ground is flat concrete grey, the type is Bricolage Grotesque pushed to extreme scale and condensed width at the moment of pressure, and Martian Mono appears only where the git metaphor is literal: commit hashes and commit messages. Depth comes from full-bleed color blocks (the ink plan band, the green and indigo closing doors), never from shadows. Density is generous: sections breathe at up to 140px vertical padding, and the graph keeps a fixed 60px row rhythm.

Motion is narrative, not decorative: on load the example history replays top to bottom, lane by lane, node by node, and the merge node lands last with a single expanding vermillion ring. Hovering or focusing a door highlights its own lane and dims the other.

The same metaphor carries past the landing. A form is a lane and each group of fields is a commit whose node fills once the group is valid. A plan's benefits are commits on the green branch. Inside the product, the developer's navigation is their own green lane, plan quotas are rows of commit slots, repositories read as a commit log, and job offers arrive as a short indigo branch from the companies.
keyCharacteristics: One line weight (3px) for every stroke in the world.
One color per role: green is the developer, indigo is the company, vermillion is only the merge.
Circular commit nodes as the only round-dot vocabulary; pills for every interactive outline.
Flat depth; hierarchy through full-bleed color bands and type scale.
Monospace reserved for hashes and commit messages.

rules.name: The One Merge Rule
rules.body: Vermillion appears only on the merge node, where the two branches meet. It is never a button, a link, a highlight, or a heading color.

rules.name: The Role Ownership Rule
rules.body: Green always means developer and indigo always means company, in lanes, doors, titles, and focus outlines. A role color never decorates content belonging to the other role or to neither.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Green Rule
rules.body: Text on Branch Green is Graph Ink, not white; text on Signal Indigo is white. Green-as-text on the grey ground uses Deep Branch Green.

rules.name: The Neutral Door Rule
rules.body: A surface that serves both roles (login, the public plans) uses Graph Ink for its lane and submit button; it only takes a role color once the visitor has chosen a role.

rules.name: The Pressure Word Rule
rules.body: Extreme scale and condensed width are spent on one word per viewport, set against a light-weight run-in. Headlines below it stay at 750 and never compete.

rules.name: The Terminal Voice Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono is only for commit hashes and commit messages. It is never used for labels, captions, or UI chrome.

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Separation is a line or a color block; if a surface needs to stand out, change its fill or draw a rule, never add a shadow.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Every stroke is `--ww-line` (3px): lanes, curves, node borders, section dividers, pill borders, link underlines, focus outlines. Do not introduce a second structural weight.

dos: **Do** scope every public surface with the `.ww` class and read colors, line, fonts, easing, and gutter from the `--ww-*` custom properties.
**Do** draw every stroke at `--ww-line` (3px): dividers, pill borders, underlines, lanes, node rings, and focus outlines.
**Do** keep green for developer, indigo for company, and vermillion for the merge node only.
**Do** use `--ww-ease-out` (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) at 200-260ms for state changes, and gate entrance choreography behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
**Do** keep a focus-visible outline on every interactive element, in the role color where the element belongs to a role.
**Do** label example history as an example; commit rows carry illustrative data, not claims. The same goes for plan prices.
**Do** draw progress and quotas as commit nodes (a filled node is done or used, a hollow node is pending or free) before reaching for numbers alone.
**Do** give every data block its own loading, error and empty sentence, and never render limits or counts that have not loaded.
donts: **Don't** add box-shadows or elevation; separate with the 3px line or a full-bleed color band.
**Don't** use vermillion on buttons, links, headings, or highlights.
**Don't** set white text on Branch Green or green text below Deep Branch Green on the grey ground.
**Don't** use Martian Mono for anything but commit hashes and messages.
**Don't** round section or band corners; radius is reserved for pills (999px) and circular nodes.
**Don't** carry the Angular Material indigo-pink palette or Roboto into `.ww` surfaces.
**Don't** box inputs or wrap plans and dashboard blocks in cards; a field is a 3px bottom rule and a group is separated by a line.
**Don't** use Error Red for anything but form errors and alerts.
